import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n;
    static int t;
    static Room[][] floorplan;

    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        double length;

        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            this.from = f;
            this.to = t;
            this.length = l;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Graph {
        List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Graph(int nr_nodes, int nr_edges) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nr_nodes; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
            // edges list will be populated dynamically
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
            Edge e = new Edge(from, to, length);
            edges.add(e);
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        List<Integer> findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] pathCap) {
            PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingDouble(p -> -p.first));
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
            capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            q.offer(new Pair(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source));

            while (!q.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
                Pair current = q.poll();
                double cap = current.first;
                int n = current.second;

                for (int e_idx : nodes.get(n).out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(e_idx);
                    double e_cap = e.length - flow[e_idx];
                    if (e_cap > 0 && Math.min(cap, e_cap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                        capacity[e.to] = Math.min(cap, e_cap);
                        pred[e.to] = e_idx;
                        q.offer(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                    }
                }
            }

            pathCap[0] = capacity[sink];
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int e_idx = pred[sink];
            while (e_idx != -1) {
                path.add(e_idx);
                e_idx = pred[edges.get(e_idx).from];
            }
            Collections.reverse(path);
            return path;
        }

        double maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), edges.size() * 2);
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                residual.addEdge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
                residual.addEdge(e.to, e.from, 0);
            }
            double[] flow = new double[residual.edges.size()];
            double[] pathCap = new double[1];
            double maxFlow = 0;

            List<Integer> path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);
            while (pathCap[0] > 0) {
                for (int e_idx : path) {
                    int e_ridx = e_idx % 2 == 0 ? e_idx + 1 : e_idx - 1;
                    flow[e_idx] += pathCap[0];
                    flow[e_ridx] -= pathCap[0];
                }
                path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);
            }

            for (int e_idx : residual.nodes.get(source).out) {
                maxFlow += flow[e_idx];
            }
            return maxFlow;
        }

        void printAll() {
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
                Node node = nodes.get(i);
                System.out.print(idToString(i) + " has edges to : ");
                for (int e_idx : node.out) {
                    System.out.print(idToString(edges.get(e_idx).to) + " ");
                }
                System.out.println();
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        double first;
        int second;

        Pair(double f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists = 0;
        int capsules = 0;

        Room() {
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static String idToString(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        int row = (id - 2) % n;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
        return "(" + row + "," + col + "," + timestamp + ")";
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        floorplan = new Room[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (floorplan[i][j] == null) floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) {
                        floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int totalNodes = n * n * (t + 1) + 2;
        Graph g = new Graph(totalNodes, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) g.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) g.maxFlow(0, 1));
    }

    static void setInfected(int i, int j, int timestamp) {
        floorplan[i][j].setInfected(timestamp);
        if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp);
        if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp);
        if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp);
        if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp);
    }
}
